description: SCOUT's building rasterizer, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Rasterize Buildings node turns a buildings layer into the zoom-16 height tiles SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model reads, and a mosaic of them in metres that an Autark map draws.
name: SCOUT Raster Conversion

templates.description: SCOUT's OSM vector to raster: draws each building's height into 256 by 256 map tiles at a zoom level, 8-bit gray where 255 is the maximum height, in EPSG:3395. Input: a buildings GeoDataFrame with a column of heights in metres. Output: (mosaic, tiles): one RASTER of the tiles side by side, heights in metres, for an Autark map; and a table with one row per tile (zoom, x, y and its PNG in base64), the tiles SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model reads.
templates.label: Rasterize Buildings
